overall: Tomorrow (Sunday, June 28) in Atlanta is expected to be a hot, partly sunny day with a slight chance of showers and thunderstorms between 8am and 2pm, clearing by afternoon. The NWS forecasts a high near 92°F with heat index values as high as 98°F, driven by southwest/west winds 5-10 mph with gusts to 20 mph.
